quote: Customer data is stored in Sirius's data centres in Malaysia and Singapore. Sirius may relocate data between its facilities at its sole discretion for operational reasons.
policy_quote: EU customer data must remain in the EU. Any clause permitting vendor to process EU customer data outside the EU is a violation. Violation: silence on data residency, or any clause allowing US/APAC processing of EU data.
reason: Storage in Malaysia and Singapore, with relocation at Sirius's discretion, allows APAC processing of customer data. That matches the listed violation for a clause allowing US/APAC processing of EU data.
suggested_fix: Amend §2 so EU customer data stays in the EU/EEA and cannot be relocated to Malaysia or Singapore.
